title: OneNote: Copilot Chat can create, edit and refine notebook content
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and Microsoft's tenant notice, including the expected rollout, platform scope and lack of an immediate admin action. The Frontier path, roles and preview licensing are supported; the remaining feature-specific licensing, automation and behaviour gaps were independently searched and remain unconfirmed.
